label: Formulated and introduced The Burnout Society & Self-Exploitation
description: Byung-Chul Han formulated and introduced the concept of "The Burnout Society & Self-Exploitation", which became a seminal contribution in political philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in political.
historicalContext: Introduced during the Contemporary & Post-Structural as part of Byung-Chul Han's canonical writings.

label: Synthesizes psychoanalytic disavowal with critiques of the neoliberal achievement society and compulsory positivity
description: Alenka Zupančič synthesized Byung-Chul Han's framework with contrasting philosophical traditions to produce a novel unified philosophical system.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Byung-Chul Han's perspective to Alenka Zupančič's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Direct contemporaneous dialogue and pedagogical transmission during the Contemporary & Post-Structural era.
